description: List recorded contributions (gifts) given within a date range, optionally narrowed by giver (with their family), amount, payment method, fund, envelope, batch or form. Read-only: this server never adds, edits or deletes gifts. Legacy endpoint: no longer shown on Breeze's current API reference; churches whose giving runs through Tithely may get an error. Breeze: GET /api/giving/list.

amount_max.description: Only gifts of at most this amount.

amount_min.description: Only gifts of at least this amount.

envelope_number.description: Only gifts with this envelope number.

include_family.description: With person_id: include gifts from the giver's family members.

person_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the giver.

name: breeze_list_contributions
title: List contributions
